Loosen the Rings Rules

Loosen the Rings is a puzzle of rings hooked into each other: turn them until one after the other slips off.

The rules

Rings
Every ring has a gap. Rings that overlap are hooked into each other like the links of a chain: at one of their two crossings the one lies on top, at the other the other one - the ring underneath is drawn broken there.
Turning
Tap a ring to turn it a quarter turn clockwise; the two buttons turn the chosen ring left or right. Every ring hooked into it turns a quarter the other way, like gears.
Free
A ring is free when its gap sits at the crossing where the hooked ring lies on top - for every ring still hooked into it. A ring hooked to two or more rings cannot come free yet. Tap a free ring and it comes out.
Goal
Take out all the rings. The line above the rings shows the fewest moves; turning and taking out each count as one move.
Levels
Easy: 3 rings. Medium: 4 or 5. Hard: 6 or 7, with a ring hooked to three others.
Help
Undo takes back a move. Hint marks the ring for the next move of a shortest way. There is no time limit.

Example

Ring 1 is hooked only into ring 2. Its gap sits at the upper crossing, where ring 2 lies on top - so ring 1 is free. Ring 2 is not free yet: its gap is not at the lower crossing, where ring 1 lies on top.
